title: A compleat map of North-Carolina from an actual survey
creator: John Collet; engraved by J. Bayly; published by S. Hooper
institution: Library of Congress, Geography and Map Division
copy: LOC Copy 1, cataloged 1770 impression; digital JP2 service derivative of institutional scan, NOT a downloaded TIFF master or a later printed facsimile. Paper history not independently examined.
rights: LOC Geography and Map Division says digitized content is free to use and reuse unless a Rights Advisory indicates otherwise. No restrictive advisory identified in this item. Credit Library of Congress, Geography and Map Division.
selection_reason: Full native dimensions, direct institutional download, documented catalog and reuse terms. UNC leads inaccessible beyond access shell; no global claim that this is the finest surviving scan. Copy 2 also cataloged, but not processed.
unc_leads: Both supplied UUIDs returned access-app shells; identities unresolved. NCpedia identifies separate legacy ncmaps/467 as Collet.
preservation: Original JP2 unchanged. All warps, masks, thumbnails and annotations are derivatives.
verification: Checksum matches preserved institutional download. Full overview re-inspected; title, main map, central sheet seam and cartouche confirmed.
